rows.quote: We shipped our first Vera Rubin samples to customers earlier this week, and we remain on track to commence production shipments in the second half of the year.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA管理层称，公司本周已向客户交付首批Vera Rubin样品，并预计2026年下半年开始量产出货。
rows.reason: NVIDIA says it has shipped initial Vera Rubin samples to customers—an actual sample shipment—and forecasts production shipments in 2026’s second half; the latter is a plan, not proof production shipments have begun.

rows.quote: In fiscal year 2026, we unveiled the NVIDIA Rubin platform, which is expected to commence production shipments in the second half of fiscal year 2027.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA预计Rubin平台将在FY2027下半年开始生产出货。
rows.reason: NVIDIA forecasts Rubin platform production shipments in the second half of FY2027. This is prospective guidance; the material does not establish how that fiscal-year timing maps to calendar 2026.

rows.quote: We are on track to commence production shipments of VeraRubin in the second half of this year starting in Q3.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 表示，Vera Rubin 计划于2026年下半年开始量产出货，起始时间为第三季度。
rows.reason: The CEO forecasts production shipments starting in Q3 and continuing in the second half of the year. This is management guidance, not evidence shipments have occurred.

rows.quote: Announced the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, including the NVIDIA Vera CPU, the world’s first processor purpose-built for agentic AI, and NVIDIA BlueField®-4 STX, accelerated storage infrastructure for agentic AI factories.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA宣布Vera Rubin平台，包括面向智能体AI的Vera CPU及BlueField-4 STX加速存储基础设施。
rows.reason: The platform and Vera CPU announcement establishes product availability as an announced offering, but does not show production shipments, customer deployments, or realized revenue.

rows.quote: We expect our Rubin platform to start shipping in the second half of fiscal year 2027.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA 表示，预计Rubin平台将在FY2027下半年开始出货。
rows.reason: NVIDIA expects Rubin platform shipments in the second half of FY2027. This is a forecast, and the source does not establish the fiscal-to-calendar-year relationship or actual shipments.

rows.quote: AI Summit — SK Group and NVIDIA today announced plans for a $500-billion-plus comprehensive partnership to establish AI infrastructure serving the surging demand for global compute. The two sides signed letters of intent to formalize the agreement, which spans from AI factory construction to AI memory supply.
rows.one_line: SK Group与NVIDIA于2026年7月24日宣布计划开展规模超过5000亿美元的综合合作，并签署意向书，合作涵盖AI工厂建设和AI内存供应。
rows.reason: SK Group and NVIDIA announced a planned partnership spanning AI factory construction and AI memory supply, with letters of intent to formalize it. The plan points toward deployment and supply-chain activity, but is not evidence the comprehensive agreement or deployments are complete.

rows.quote: This cloud will use the NVIDIA ® DSX™ platform and deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin accelerated computing powered by SK hynix HBM4, with the first AI factory planned to come online in 2027.
rows.one_line: SK Telecom计划在2027年让首座AI工厂上线，该工厂将采用NVIDIA DSX平台和由SK hynix HBM4驱动的Vera Rubin加速计算。
rows.reason: SK Telecom says its first AI factory using Vera Rubin is planned to come online in 2027. This supports a prospective customer deployment, not an operational deployment or completed shipment.

rows.quote: SK hynix is also entering into a long-term AI memory partnership with NVIDIA.
rows.one_line: SK hynix与NVIDIA建立长期AI内存合作关系。
rows.reason: The source reports an established long-term AI memory partnership between SK hynix and NVIDIA, relevant to supplying the Vera Rubin commercialization pathway; it does not establish Vera Rubin shipments or revenue.

rows.quote: The two companies will codevelop and optimize next-generation AI memory solutions, including HBM, to meet evolving infrastructure demands ranging from large language model training to agentic AI and physical AI .
rows.one_line: NVIDIA与SK hynix将共同开发和优化包括HBM在内的下一代AI内存解决方案，以满足基础设施需求。
rows.reason: The companies say they will co-develop and optimize next-generation AI memory including HBM. This is a prospective supply-chain commitment, not evidence of delivered memory or Vera Rubin revenue.

rows.quote: The 200-megawatt AI factory is expected to feature advanced NVIDIA AI infrastructure including the NVIDIA Vera Rubin and NVIDIA Blackwell platforms.
rows.one_line: 这座预计建成 200 兆瓦的 AI 工厂预计将配置包括 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 和 NVIDIA Blackwell 平台在内的 NVIDIA AI 基础设施。
rows.reason: The announced 200-megawatt AI factory is expected to feature Vera Rubin infrastructure. This is prospective deployment guidance, not proof the factory is built or operating.

rows.quote: Core to it all: NAVER, Brookfield and NVIDIA will expand NAVER’s NVIDIA DSX AI factory at its GAK Sejong data center to 200 megawatts — roughly 100,000 GPUs, built on the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform — more than tripling the initial buildout announced in June .
rows.one_line: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 7 月 24 日称，NAVER、Brookfield 和 NVIDIA 将把 NAVER 的 GAK Sejong AI 工厂扩至 200 兆瓦、约 10 万块 GPU，并采用 Vera Rubin 平台。
rows.reason: NVIDIA says the partners will expand NAVER’s AI factory to 200 megawatts, with roughly 100,000 GPUs built on Vera Rubin. This is an announced plan, not an accomplished deployment or shipment.

rows.quote: Broadening initial plans announced in June , the expanded collaboration will deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure powered by SK hynix HBM4 memory.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 7 月 24 日称，扩大的 SK 合作将部署由 SK hynix HBM4 内存支持的 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 基础设施。
rows.reason: NVIDIA says the expanded collaboration will deploy Vera Rubin infrastructure powered by SK hynix HBM4. This is prospective deployment and supply-chain evidence, not proof deployment or revenue has occurred.

rows.quote: On the May 20 earnings call, Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and CFO, said Vera “opens a brand new $200 billion TAM for NVIDIA, a market we have never addressed before,” adding: “We have visibility to nearly $20 billion in total CPU revenue this year, setting us up to become the world-leading CPU supplier.”
rows.one_line: NVIDIA CFO Colette Kress 在 2026 年 5 月 20 日财报电话会上表示，公司预计当年 CPU 总收入接近 200 亿美元。
rows.reason: The CFO forecasts nearly $20 billion in total CPU revenue for the year. This is management guidance, not realized revenue, and the source does not establish that the forecast has been achieved.

rows.quote: Vivek Arya of Bank of America asked whether the $20 billion was standalone or already embedded in Vera Rubin systems. CEO Jensen Huang: “The $20 billion is for standalone CPU.”
rows.one_line: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 在 2026 年 5 月 20 日财报电话会上澄清，接近 200 亿美元的 CPU 收入预期指独立 CPU。
rows.reason: The CEO clarifies that the nearly $20 billion CPU revenue forecast refers to standalone CPUs, making it relevant to Vera commercialization. It remains a forecast, not actual revenue.

rows.quote: That day, one before AMD’s Advancing AI conference, NVIDIA published the full architecture and benchmarks for Vera, its first CPU built on custom Olympus cores.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 7 月 21 日发布了 Vera 架构和基准测试；Vera 是其首款采用定制 Olympus 核心的 CPU。
rows.reason: Publishing Vera architecture and benchmarks is evidence of product readiness and disclosure, but not of production shipments, customer deployments, or revenue realization.

rows.quote: Two quarters of visibility without disclosure would tell that the $20 billion is harder to isolate than the May call implied.
rows.one_line: TIKR 作者认为，若未来两个季度没有单独披露 CPU 收入，接近 200 亿美元的预期可能比 5 月电话会暗示的更难单独核实。
rows.reason: The author raises a conditional concern that absent separate disclosure over two quarters, the standalone CPU revenue forecast may be harder to verify. This challenges revenue visibility, not the forecast itself or actual revenue results.

rows.quote: Two drivers carry the mid-case revenue growth rate of around 23% annually. The first is the standalone CPU line Huang placed outside the $1 trillion forecast, a category with no prior revenue history at NVIDIA.
rows.one_line: TIKR 作者认为，独立 CPU 产品线是其估值中约 23% 年收入增长假设的驱动因素之一。
rows.reason: The author describes standalone CPU as a growth driver with no prior NVIDIA revenue history. That highlights execution and revenue-realization uncertainty; the cited growth rate is an analytical assumption, not a result.

rows.quote: The second is rising content per rack as Vera Rubin’s seven-chip architecture, which Kress said starts shipping in Q3 and ramps into Q4, replaces narrower Blackwell configurations.
rows.one_line: TIKR 作者转述 NVIDIA CFO Colette Kress 的说法：Vera Rubin 七芯片架构从第三季度开始出货，并在第四季度爬坡。
rows.reason: The CFO is reported as saying Vera Rubin starts shipping in Q3 and ramps in Q4. This is a shipment forecast, not evidence of actual shipments or revenue.
